Package com.noorlandmc.NoorCore.anticheat

Class PingAnomalyTracker

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorCore.anticheat.PingAnomalyTracker
public class PingAnomalyTracker extends Object
Anti-cheat module that monitors player network latency (ping) patterns to identify and flag potential connection manipulation or abuse.

This tracker maintains per-player ping history and detects anomalies such as sudden spikes or repeated fluctuations that may indicate lag switches or other exploitation methods used to gain unfair advantages in combat.

Monitored Violations:

  • Ping spikes - sudden increases in latency above baseline
  • Repeated spike patterns - multiple spikes in a rolling window suggesting intentional manipulation

  • Method Details

    • tick

      public void tick(org.bukkit.entity.Player player)
      Called periodically (typically once per second) to analyze a player's current ping against their historical baseline.

      Maintains a rolling history of ping values and detects spikes. When a spike is detected, it is logged and counted. If the spike count reaches MAX_TOLERATED_SPIKES within the rolling window, a PING_MANIPULATION flag is issued and the spike counter is reset.

      Requires at least 5 baseline measurements before spike detection begins.

      Parameters:
      player - the player whose ping should be analyzed

    • isCurrentlySpike

      public boolean isCurrentlySpike(org.bukkit.entity.Player player)
      Checks if a player is currently experiencing a ping spike relative to their average.

      Useful for cross-referencing with other anti-cheat checks (e.g., flagging combat events that occur during suspicious ping spikes). Returns false if no ping history exists for the player yet.

      Parameters:
      player - the player to check
      Returns:
      true if the player's current ping exceeds their average by more than SPIKE_THRESHOLD_MS, false otherwise
